SMALL_AFK_KICK: Kicked for not moving for {0} minutes
SMALL_ERR_JOB: This way is for staff only
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: Small gameplay features, each with its own switch.
ADMIN_H_SEATBELT: B buckles up in cars; a buckled player cannot leave the vehicle and survives faster crashes.
ADMIN_H_EJECT: A crash above this speed throws the driver through the windscreen.
ADMIN_H_CRUISE: Y holds the current speed as the vehicle's top speed until pressed again.
ADMIN_H_NO_SHUFFLE: A passenger stays in their seat when the driver gets out.
ADMIN_H_TACKLE: G while sprinting knocks down the player right in front.
ADMIN_H_BINOCULARS: Using binoculars opens a zoom camera.
ADMIN_H_FIREWORKS: Fireworks are placed on the ground and go off after 5 seconds.
ADMIN_H_AFK: Players who do not move for this long are kicked (admins never). 0 turns it off.
ADMIN_H_NO_DISPATCH: No wanted level and no AI police, ambulance or fire trucks.
ADMIN_H_HIDE_HUD: Hides GTA's cash, area, street and vehicle names (the ai-hud shows its own).
ADMIN_TAB_TELEPORTS_DESC: Doors and elevators that take players between two points.
ADMIN_C_TELEPORT_DESC: A prompt at both ends takes the player to the other end.
KEYBIND_NEWS_VIEW: News camera view (while holding the camera)
